snippet.title: Cards of Prophecy - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the demo announcement trailer for Cards of Prophecy, a game that blends tower defense, roguelike, and deckbuilder mechanics, all presented in a low-poly 3D style. Inspired by trading card games, players protect the Great Magician using a deck of magical summons and powerful spells. Cards of Prophecy will be available on PC (Steam), and a demo launches on March 6, 2026.
